sections.Profile:
"Southern Belle," released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in June 1955, is a single-player, electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. The game features a riverboat theme, with the backglass depicting a classic Southern scene.
